notes.title: Patch Notes 1.7.1.1 - PlayStation crossplay
notes.notes:
Hello Bounty Hunters!

We're deploying a small patch today that will improve and fix some issues, but most importantly it'll enable crossplay between PC and PlayStation when the game is released on [b]PS4 and PS5 this Thursday, July 20th[/b].
[list]
[*] Addressed some graphical issues that diminished the experience.
[*] Improved the texture streaming that forced low resolution textures during longplay sessions.
[*] Fixed some rendering issues with items in the rewards screens.
[*] Fixed an audio memory corruption issue which could crash the game.
[*] Crossplay between PC and PlayStation is now available. Please note that for PlayStation players, a PlayStation Plus subscription is required for online co-op.
[/list]
Also, to celebrate the arrival of Killsquad to PlayStation, we've activated our biggest discount yet, and you can now get Killsquad at [b]65% off until Sunday[/b]! Tell your friends and go together for some mayhem hunting!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/910490/Killsquad/

See you in space, Bounty Hunters!

[h1]Killsquad mini update, version 1.6.4.11[/h1]

Hello Bounty Hunters!

Since the big optimization update called “Under the Hood” many bugs have emerged because of the big changes made. We have launched two hotfixes solving major bugs and crashes. The list of [b]bugs fixed[/b] is the following:
[list]
[*]The leaderboard of [i]Infinite Colosseum[/i] would not save and update the score properly.
[*]Cass’ shuriken skill had the possibility of getting in infinite cooldown sometimes.
[*]The terminal area of the contract “[i]SHUT IT DOWN[/i]” wasn’t appearing.
[*]When a player, playing as a client, would return to the lobby while in a contract it get blocked with a black screen 
[*]A player would get stuck in a colosseum if another one got out of the contract in the round exchange.
[*]UI icons in the contract map menu would make a weird shake when the player was moving the map or making zoom.
[*]Fixed a block in “[i]FOR THE UPRISING[/i]” contract that would occur sometimes with the Scrappy.

If you are still experiencing crashes you can contact us directly at [b]killsquad@novarama.com[/b], and send us your "[u]Saved" folder[/u]. notes.title: New Hotfix Released
notes.notes:
Hello Bounty Hunters!

After the last hotfix, there were some critical bugs that still remained in the game. Thanks to your help with reporting these issues, and the work of our dev team, we are now able to release a new patch that will get rid of these bugs. We hope that now you can finally play without issues and we apologise for any inconvenience the last patch caused.


List of bugs fixed:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the deactivation of “[i]The Runaway[/i]” traps after defeating him, making it possible to be killed after successfully finalizing the contract.
[*]Fixed a bug with the [i]game trackers[/i] that disabled unlocking the game’s achievements 
[*]Fixed a graphical UI bug that rendered the lobby invitation buttons unavailable.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the proper unlocking of the [i]inferno contracts[/i], the [i]infinite[/i], & [i]elemental colosseums[/i].
[*]We have also fixed six specific crashes that some of you reported & helped identify.
[/list]


If you are still experiencing crashes you can contact us directly at  [b]killsquad@novarama.com[/b], and send us your "[u]Saved[/u]" folder. (you can find it in   [u]C:\Users%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad[/u]). For other issues, your reports via the bug-report channel on discord & Steam discussion are very helpful.

Hope that this patch makes your experience with Killsquad is better & smoother than ever.

See you in space, Bounty Hunters!


By the way, you can still sign up for our Insider Program here: https://novarama.com/novarama-insider-program/

notes.title: Killsquad “Under the Hood” Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Killsquad Update 1.6.1.4  [/h1]

Welcome Bounty Hunters,

First of all, we want to say huge thanks to all of you who have taken the time to report to us all the bugs, issues, and problems that you encountered. All of your feedback was the foundation of the update that’s now in your download queue. 

This new update is all about making Killsquad a much better experience. As we’re gearing up for the PS4 release of Killsquad (cross-play incoming!) we’ve made changes in the game’s core engine code and we gave Killsquad a performance upgrade too. We also added a new online system based on *EOS* so that we can improve online service and make the game well-prepared to crossplay with the incoming PS4 version. 

To make your whole experience with Killsquad better, we’ve changed a lot of the game’s code. We had to make sure that this version is stable and it’s compatible with the PS4 device. To achieve that we had to re-work the [i]particle/VFX system[/i] in CPU costs, tweak the [i]animation system[/i], the [i]simulation of movement[/i], and also the [i]network processing[/i]. During all these changes a lot of bugs and problems occurred which we had to fix too. So this whole process took us quite a bit of time. But all of that work was definitely worth it, because as a result, we now have a much more optimized game! 

Also, we’ve fixed the occasional crashes that some of you reported to us. Thanks to your help,Killsquad is more steady than ever.

[u]Most important crashes fixed:[/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that occur opening reward chests
[*]Fixed a crash that was provoked by Cass’ shuriken skill.
[*]Fixed random crashes during contracts.
[*]Fixed a crash that occurs during the Splash Screen
[/list]

And finally, we have made fixes of other [u]minor bugs[/u] (not crashing issues) that the Community have reported and many more that came up during the development of new systems and improvements.

[u]Minor bugs fixed:[/u]
[list]
[*]Various localization bugs fixed on several items/cosmetics
[*]Fixed performance issues with Meteors that spawn on some contracts
[*]Fixed some rendering bugs related to the UI, lighting and also some contracts, that sometimes were shown too lighted
[*]Fixed a bug where 2 assets of lamps were blocking the view of the game camera in some situations in the M.A.G.N.U.S battle.
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes the healing done in a contract was negative.
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes Gadgets were not shown on the UI playing a contract as a client
[*]Fixed a bug where the traps located at “Trouble in paradise” contract, were not working properly playing as a client.
[*]Fixed a bug where Numpad keys were not bindable in the game inputs.
[*]Fixed a bug where some mobs spawned by Queen Mogoth got stuck under the ground.
[*]Fixed a bug where Zero would keep the attack beam on while dead.
[*]Fixed a bug where the traps of [i]Hunted Hunter[/i] contract were working incorrectly.
[*]Fixed a bug where the [i]Jotuns[/i] enemies on the contract [i]Crazy about Jade[/i] were not eliminated at the end of the mission and were stopping if the player placed in front of them
[*]Fixed a minor bug where faction emote visuals were incorrectly distorted in the 3D preview
[*]Fixed a minor bug where a light flash would appear on the screen every time you click on a gadget in the menus.
[*]Fixed a bug where the tail of Queen Moggoth had physics and movement after it was cut. 
[*]Fixed a bug where Trouble in Paradise lasers were working weirdly playing as a client
[*]Fixed a bug where the “ready light” in the lobby was rendering badly.
[/list]

[b]What’s next & what are we doing right now:[/b]
[list]
[*]Finishing the PS4 port.
[*]Polishing and bug fixing.
[/list]

If your game crashes, a Crash reporter will appear, add the details of what you were doing at the time of the crash and send it to us. If you want to, you can also contact us directly at killsquad@novarama.com, and send us your "Saved" folder. (you can find it in   C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad). This will be very helpful.

For those of you that might not know, part of our studio is working on a new project. We haven’t revealed what it is yet, but we would love to show you the game first, before everyone else. We are looking for testers from both the US and EU regions. If you would like to get an early peek at what we are working on, [url=https://novarama.com/novarama-insider-program/]just sign up here[/url]!

Thank you so much for all your input and help. And please, if you have any questions or feedback, write it all down in the comments below.


Until then,

See you in space bounty hunters!

Your Novarama Team

notes.title: New Killsquad update is now available to download
notes.notes:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

It’s been a while, hasn’t it!? Although we haven't spoken much recently, it doesn't mean that work on the game has stopped. Back in our studio, behind closed doors, we’ve been working on making Killsquad even better for you, our players. In this update you will find some new additions to the game that we hope will hit that Killsquad crave spot. So, here we go!

First up, Killsquad is getting [b]10 never-seen-before skill upgrades![/b] From now on, each Hero will have 2 upgrades available. One of them with a cost of 1 TEC and the second with 2 TECs. Don’t have enough TECs? Not to worry! Go and play the Spec. Ops contracts and start collecting those sweet TECs right now!

If you are a fan of the Infinite or Elemental Colosseums, we have something just for you. With this update, you will get [b]4 new gear perks[/b] waiting for your disposal. [i]Heal Up The Sleeve[/i], [i]Resting Stash[/i], [i]Prototype G[/i], and [i]Remedial Recovery[/i] can be added to your arsenal today and tip the balance of victory in your favour. Here’s a little brief intro on them:

[u]Heal Up The Sleeve[/u] (exclusive for Troy): pick up a Card, and heal yourself by 1500 hp.
[u]Resting Stash[/u] (all characters, exclusive legendary): reach a Resting Round in a Colosseum and gain 2 of each equipped Gadget (Gadget amount cannot exceed the max, total).
[u]Prototype G[/u] (All characters, exclusive legendary): use a Gadget drone that follows you around. The drone will activate a random gadget effect every 5 seconds.
[u]Remedial Recovery[/u] (All characters): boost your Basic Attacks with 50% lifesteal for 7 seconds. You can use this perk after successfully performing a Recovery.

But this is not all. [i]The Invulnerable Dodge[/i] gear perk that was exclusive to Troy is now available to all Killsquad characters! Now the whole squad can use Invulnerable Dodge without any restrictions. 

From now on while fighting in Elemental Colosseums you can unlock [b]12 new cosmetics[/b] for your heroes! In addition to getting that almighty feeling of victory, you can now also enjoy a visual upgrade in the appearance of your hero too. 

Here is the list of the new cosmetics:

[u]TROY[/u]:
Aerodynamic Boots (Legs)
Ronin Dō (Body)

[u]CASS[/u]:
Corrupted Flux Mask (Head)
Recycled Plate Armor (Body)
The Queen's Membrane (Body)

[u]KOSMO[/u]:
The Doorstopper (Body)
Customized Knight Gauntlets (Arms)

[u]ZERO[/u]:
Shin Pads (Legs)
Champion Belt (Body)

[u]EKAAR[/u]:
Cobra-style Bamboo Hat (Head)
Copperplate Droid Arms (Arms)
Mutation Remnants (Legs) 


And last but not least. We made some changes to the radar in the game. [b]The Radar now shows the position of your enemies[/b]. Nearby enemies will appear as red circles on the radar, while those distant once will be shown as a red glow. 

Those are just the main changes that we’ve implemented. We’ve also did a lot of smaller quality of life improvements too. If you want to know more details about all of the changes, check out our changelog below. 

Hope you will all enjoy Killsquad’s new additions and have an even better time with our game. And as always if you have any questions, thoughts, leave them in the comment section down below.


May the universe be freed from alien scum.

You can see more detail on full patch notes down below, 


Good luck Bounty Hunters,

Your Novarama Team.


[h2]Killsquad Update v.1.4.0.1[/h2]
 
A new Killsquad Update is here! And it comes with many and varied novelties! Let's start with a short summary of the highlights of the new content:
 
+ 10 brand new skill upgrades for our 5 favorite bounty hunters!
+ 4 brand new gear perks that are especially useful in the hard infinite colosseums.
+ A very nice gear perk that was exclusive to Troy is now available to all characters!
+ 12 new cosmetics unlockable by playing in Elemental Colosseums so you can go bounty hunting in style.
+ The Radar now shows the position of enemies.
 
[b]NEW HEROES SKILL UPGRADES[/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
[b]10 Brand new skill upgrades[/b] are coming for our heroes. Each Hero will have 2 upgrades with a cost of 1 and 2 TECs. You can now play the Spec.Ops contracts to get the extra TECs needed to get these upgrades!
 
[u]Hero Skill Upgrade Glossary[/u]
 
+ [b]TROY[/b]
• [b]Substitution Technique[/b] (1 TEC cost): Whenever Troy performs a [i]Recovery[/i],he creates a clone that lasts for 5 second(s). This clone deals 10% its normal damage and taunts nearby enemies.
• [b]Tactical Repositioning[/b] (2 TEC cost): Whenever Troy dodges, he drops 3 land mines on the ground. When an enemy steps on them, they explode, dealing area damage to nearby enemies.
 
+ [b]KOSMO[/b]
• [b]Clobberin' Time[/b] (1 TEC cost): After slamming the ground with [i]Whirlwind[/i], Kosmo's attack speed increases by 35% for 5 second(s).
• [b]Ground Tremors[/b] (2 TEC cost): After slamming the ground during [i]Whirlwind[/i], Kosmo launches a seismic wave, dealing 250 damage to any enemy it hits and sending them flying.
 
+ [b]CASS[/b]
• [b]Silent Recovery[/b] (1 TEC cost): After performing a [i]Recovery[/i], Cass [i]Phase Shifts[/i], turning invisible. Reactivating the Skill while invisible will make her carry out an area attack. Exiting stealth or using [i]Phase Shift's[/i] area attack will not put the Skill on cooldown.
• [b]Phased Healing[/b] (2 TEC cost): Enemies killed by [i]Phase Shift[/i] heal Cass based on her max Health (Basic Type enemies heal for 1% of Cass's max Health, Medium Type enemies heal for 5%, and Semiboss/Boss Type enemies heal for 40%).
 
+ [b]ZERO[/b]
• [b]PHD in Death[/b] (1 TEC cost): Allies revived by Zero are healed for an additional (). Health [i]Medpacks[/i] dropped by Zero appear instantly.
• [b]Rechargable batteries[/b] (2 TEC cost): Hitting enemies with Zero's [i]Basic Attacks[/i] charges a sidebar. When the bar is full, the next [i]Basic Attack[/i] will shoot a [i]Photon Bolt[/i] (any Photon Bolt upgrades will apply)
 
+ [b]EKAAR[/b]
• [b]Tracking Shield[/b] (1 TEC cost): While active, [i]Beta Shield[/i] will always point in the direction Ekaar is facing.
• [b]Fast Hands[/b] (2 TEC cost): Ekaar's [i]Basic Attack's[/i] reload speed is increased by 20% while his [i]Photonic bar[/i] is below ().
 
[b]NEW GEAR PERKS[/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
There are 4 new gear perks and some are especially useful in infinite/elemental coliseums:
 
+ [b]Heal Up The Sleeve[/b] ([i]Exclusive Troy gear perk[/i]): When you pick up a [i]Card[/i], Troy heals 1500 Health.
 
+ [b]Resting Stash[/b] ([i]All characters, exclusive legendary[/i]): Every time you reach a [i]Resting Round[/i] in a Colosseum, gain 2 of each equipped Gadget (Gadget amount cannot exceed the max, total).
 
+ [b]Prototype G[/b] ([i]All characters, exclusive legendary[/i]): Generates a small Gadget drone that follows you around. Every 5 second(s), the drone will activate a random gadget effect (The gadget effects can be: Static balls/ Vampiric Pond/ Dummy, the King of Dummies/ Armor UP!) 
 
+ [b]Remedial Recovery[/b] ([i]All characters[/i]): Your [i]Basic Attacks[/i] gain 50% lifesteal for 7 second(s) after succesfully performing a [i]Recovery[/i]
 
[b]EXISTING GEAR PERK CHANGE[/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
+ [b]Invulnerable Dodge[/b]: Now this gear perk becomes available for every hero (previously was exclusive of Troy) 
 
[b]BRAND NEW COSMETICS[/b]
 
[u]General[/u]
 
There are 12 brand new cosmetics available inside the chests of Elemental Colosseums:
 
+ [b]TROY[/b]:
• Aerodynamic Boots (Legs)

We have upgraded the radar in the game. It is now more useful as you can see where the enemies are placed relative to your character. You can see nearby enemies as red circles and a red glow indicating the position of distant enemies.

[u]General[/u]
 
There is more! We have implemented other minor changes that, we hope, will make the game even better
 
+ We have changed the system of [b]Portal Colosseums[/b] to make them more dynamic as we did with Recruit and Veteran colosseums.

notes.title: Inferno Mode Update and Christmas Event are here!
notes.notes:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

Ho, ho, ho…ld onto your weapons! A brand new Killsquad’s Update that’s packed with new content is ready for you to enjoy. And this is a big one. It’s the endgame content that we promised you a few months ago. And to top it off, we’ve also added an extra bonus for you. A little something to bring the Xmas spirit to your screens. That’s right - the Killsquad Xmas event is making a comeback and is bringing some special gifts to bring you that Holiday cheer.

Welcome to the new Inferno Mode in which we have new Colosseums waiting. First up, we have [b]three new Elemental Colosseums[/b] for you to try and test your luck with. It’s the ultimate test of strength and guile in which you face hordes of alien meat. And depending on the Colosseum you choose, you will face different foes. Although they might be different, the one thing that they do have in common is that they all have a weak spot. They are weak to the two elements of each colosseum BUT they are resistant to every other element that you will hit them with. So take advantage of their elemental weakness and reap some sweet rewards! And by sweet, we mean the all [b]new Legendary Equipment![/b] There is a Legendary Weapon, a Legendary Gear, and a Legendary Prototype waiting for a Bounty Hunter just like you. You can find the new Legendary Weapons, and Legendary Support/Prototype Gears by completing the Elemental Colosseums. You can also find [b]Perks[/b] for the [b]New Customization System[/b] that the Legendary Equipment have, letting you choose what upgrades they can carry to better fit your builds and playstyles.

We are also bringing you the [b]Infinite Colosseum[/b] - a place with no round limit, but with each new wave, it gets harder and harder, until it may be impossible to continue. How long will you survive? You can play the Colosseum like you normally would. Or you can try out the [b]new Competitive Mode with a New Ranking system[/b]. And if you do take on the challenge and go far enough, you’ll be able to mark your name in the New Ranking system. Make yourself a part of Killsquad’s history and be known as one of the best Bounty Hunters in the universe. Depending on your ranking, you will earn a shiny new badge. The higher the ranking, the higher the tier of the badge you get. You will also gain rewards for participating. These rewards aren't subject to your position in the ranking, but more about your individual skill. These rewards will rotate on a regular basis, so if you missed out on them the first time around, you will be able to unlock them later. 

We’ve upped the Core limit of your Skills and Upgrades from 10 to 12, meaning that you now can get [b]two new additional Cores![/b] You can get those additional slots by unlocking the Veteran Contracts and the Spec. Ops. Contracts. So veterans, don’t freak out if you see two new Cores available. Since you’ve already played through those contracts, they’re there, waiting for you to make use of them. We’ve also added [b]new tiers to all the badges[/b] in the game. Now each of them will have the "Jade" and "Antimatter" tier, with new milestones for you to reach. 

And finally, for all of you alien killers out there that also love to spread Xmas joy, we have just the thing for you! Get those bells jingling as Killsquad’s 2021 [b]Christmas Event has now officially started![/b] And with it, we have all new Xmas goodies for you to unlock. We don’t want to spoil the whole fun, so we’ll leave the “discover what you can get” part all to you. But if you can, throw a snowball at one of your fellow squad members. It’ll be fun - trust us. Also, all of the previous Christmas event quests, portraits, and cosmetics are available as well. If you previously haven't had a chance to get them, well now is your chance to get them. 

For more details on what’s in the update, see our changelog below.

And finally, we want to wish you a Happy Holiday and a fantastic New Year! May this time be full of joy, peace, and happiness. We also want to thank you for making 2021 a year that we will never forget. Thank you for being part of our game and in creating a community that we are forever grateful for. 

We’ve heard your feedback from the last Steam News post so please take a look at the update, see what you think of the new content, and leave your thoughts below. And as always, we’re here to listen, so if something is on your mind, let us know. 


Have a great break, all the best, and speak to you soon,

Your Novarama Team

- A new game mode: [b]Inferno![/b] Containing 3 new Elemental Colosseums, each one based on a different combination of the elements, they will offer you new challenges and where you'll be able to find upgrades for the...

- And how about a bit of competition? The new Infinite Colosseum comes with a new [b]Competitive mode[/b]. Each round you survive you'll earn points based on your performance. - BREAKING NEWS! It seems like Ekaar may or may not be intent in ruining Christmas. Let's hope the [b]Christmas Event[/b] can put an end to his bitterness. With a new portrait, a new Cosmetic, a new Questline and a new Gadget: the Photonic Snowballs. Throw them at enemies (or allies) to knock them down to their assess. Moreover, rewards and quests from previous events are back, so if you are new or didn't get the chance to get them now is your time.


[b]ELEMENTAL COLOSSEUMS[/b]

[u]General[/u]

· [b]The Elemental Colosseums[/b] bring new custom random waves, with enemies that thematically fit and have weaknesses to the colosseum elements. Any other elements will not be effective against them.
· These Colosseums have a round limit of [b]6 rounds[/b].
· Every [b]Elemental Colosseum[/b] rewards you with a Vector 130 Legendary Equipment. You will find different types of Equipment in each Colosseum:

+ [i]The Vulcanic Colosseum[/i]
  	- Enemy weaknesses: Fire and Toxic
  	- Rewards: Vector 130 Legendary Weapon, 2-4 Random Legendary Weapon Perks

+ [i]The Glacier Colosseum[/i]
  	- Enemy weaknesses: Ice and Kinetic
  	- Rewards: Vector 130 Legendary Support Gear, 2-4 Random Legendary Support Gear Perks

+ [i]The Voltaic Colosseum[/i]
  	- Enemy weaknesses: Electro and Corruption
  	- Rewards: Vector 130 Legendary Prototype Gear, 2-4 Random Legendary Prototype Gear Perks

· After the third round we are introducing a new type of round: the [b]Resting Round[/b]. Here you can take a breather, heal yourself with the healing station, and a new chest. In this chest, you can find additional Legendary Equipment, a random perk or a new emote. But how do you open them? Well, that's the [b]key[/b] to the question.


[b]INFINITE COLOSSEUM[/b]

[u]General[/u]

· [b]The Infinite Colosseum[/b] brings a new feature to Colosseums: no round limit. Instead of completing the Colosseum, you are facing off against yourself and trying to beat your own record. But, with the limit removed, comes a big increase in difficulty. Each round you beat will make the next round tougher, putting your strategies and skill to the test while making it extremely hard for you to survive.
· You can play the Infinite Colosseum in [b]Normal Mode[/b] (play Solo or Co-op) or in the [b]Competitive Mode[/b] (play Solo, get your score and appear on the Ranking).

[u]Competitive Mode[/u]

· This is a [b]Solo game mode exclusively[/b]. You can still play the Infinite Colosseum in Co-op but not Competitively.
· When you play the Competitive Mode, you will [b]earn points[/b] through the rounds based on [b]4 factors[/b]:
  	-  [i]Damage Taken[/i]: More points for less damage taken.
  	-  [i]Time Trial[/i]: More points for less time.
  	-  [i]Rounds[/i]: More points for higher round.
  	-  [i]Disadvantage[/i]: More points based on the difference between your hero's vector and the enemy's vector. This is a point multiplier.

· Based on the [b]amount of points you get[/b], if you beat certain point thresholds, you'll obtain seasonal cosmetic rewards and get a position on [b]the Ranking[/b].
· [b]The Ranking[/b] is a global classification where you can see players sorted by their score playing Competitive Mode in the Infinite Colosseum.
· [b]The Ranking[/b] will reset at the end of every season, with an average duration of half a month.
· [b]Cosmetic rewards[/b] will be based on your [b]individual performance[/b]. It will not depend on your position on the ranking for you to get them. You will need to get certain amount of points to unlock certain cosmetic rewards.
. Depending on [b]your position on the Ranking[/b] at the end of a season, you will get a different tier for a [b]new badge[/b]:
  	- [i]Participant[/i]: Bronze.
  	- [i]Top 25[/i]: Silver.
  	- [i]Top 10[/i]: Gold.
  	- [i]Top 5[/i]: Jade.
  	- [i]Top 1[/i]: Antimatter.


[b]LEGENDARY EQUIPMENT[/b]

[u]General[/u]

· [b]Legendary Equipment[/b] is a new tier for weapons and gears, with new looks and 2 new exciting functionalities: they can level up and you can choose its perks.
· You will find all the [b]Legendary Equipment[/b] at Vector 130, and you can level it up to Vector 150 by consuming other pieces of equipment. The higher the Vector, Tier and what Perks the consumed equipment has, the more experience it gains.
· [b]Legendary Equipment[/b] can also be customized via the [b]Perks[/b]. Legendary weapons and gears come with slots to fit perks, which you can get from playing the Elemental Colosseums, giving you the power to create custom Weapons and Gears.

[u]Perks[/u]

· [b]Perks[/b] are upgrades you can slot once into your Legendary Equipment to give them the abilities that best fit your playstyle.
· There are [b]5 types of perks[/b] depending on the effect they have: Damage, Effect, Utility, Support, Skill.
· You can collect these perks with no limit, spending 1 each time you equip it onto a weapon or gear.
· Legendary Weapons have [b]4 slots[/b] while Legendary Gears have [b]3 slots[/b]. Once a perk is equipped you can override it with another one, but doing so deletes the equipped perk.


[b]CHRISTMAS EVENT[/b]

· New Ekaar Christmas Themed Cosmetic: [b]I'm Dreaming of a Fake Christmas[/b]. You can unlock it as part of the new Quest.

notes.notes:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

The latest update is all about the Colosseum’s core system rework. We are bringing two reworked Colosseum modes to the game to give you more variety and more gameplay. Let us tell you about today’s changes in a bit more detail.

[b]Recruit Colosseum[/b] is for those who do not fear the unknown. If you dare to enter this colosseum, you will stand against hordes of randomly spawning aliens. No Bounty Hunter knows what kind of enemy they will face here. Will it be a swarm of easy-to-kill aliens, or a pack of killers led by an even bigger killer! Nothing is certain in the Recruit Colosseum except that with each wave you manage to survive, the next will be harder to beat as enemies will have higher vector and enhancements.

The [b]Veteran Colosseum[/b] is made for those Bounty Hunters who are on the cusp of greatest - or insanity. In this colosseum you will have to use both your brains and brawn. We took the Recruit Colosseum, but we added a bit more spice to it. It’s all about enemy versatility here. You will not only come across waves of aliens, but they also have various random enhancements too! This is the place where you need to engage both sides of your brain, and not just your thumbs. Non-standard solutions are highly encouraged.

Let us know in the comment section below what you think of these changes. We will be using this system as a basis for our endgame update too, so all your feedback, all your thoughts are most welcome. Which colosseum is your favourite, are you having fun with them, and what else comes to your mind when you play? Curious to hear your thoughts. 


Good luck with the waves of aliens out there Bounty Hunter! And as always, read our changelog below for all the details.

Novarama Team



[h2]Random Colosseums update v.1.2.0.1[/h2]

The Colosseum system rework is here! In this patch we've focused on reworking how the Colosseums work in order to make them more replayable. This new system allows us to randomize and enhance the flavor and variety of enemies depending on waves, vector and more to give you a new challenge every time you enter a Colosseum! With this update, we've made these changes available in the Recruit and Veteran Colosseums, and we will use it to its best potential in the Endgame update.

[b]RECRUIT COLOSSEUM REWORK[/b]

The Recruit Colosseum has a focus on freshnes. Each time you enter the colosseum you will not know which enemies you will encounter. Maybe a wave of basic enemies trying to swarm you, or a swarm of enemies led by an elite one! In any case, the recruit Colosseum now contains all enemies you've seen on the Recruit Contracts! 

[u]General[/u]

· Added to the colosseum all enemies from the RECRUIT contracts. Every challenge you've faced on the RECRUIT contracts can spawn at a wave of the colosseum!
· Modified the System of the colosseum
    - More  basic enemies added to the spawn pool from all the RECRUIT contracts.
    - More Elite enemies added to the spawn pool from all the RECRUIT contracts.
    - Each wave you pass it gets harder in terms of vector and enhancements of enemies.
    - Enemies spawns are random. 

[b]VETERAN COLOSSEUM REWORK[/b]

The Veteran Colosseum has a focus on enemy versatility. We want you to feel the Colosseum different in many ways, so in addition to the recruit changes the system also allows a variety of enhancements to enemies that the player might need to find different ways of dealing with them. Imagine how different it is to fight against a rinosnail if it has an anti range barrier or a dolem if it has a full shield instead of HP... Join the challenge and discover the new Veteran Colosseum!

[u]General[/u]

· Added to the Colosseum all enemies from the VETERAN contracts. Every challenge you've faced on the VETERAN contracts can spawn at a wave of the Colosseum !
· Modified the system of the Colosseum 
    - More  basic enemies added to the spawn pool from all the VETERAN contracts.
    - More Elite enemies added to the spawn pool from all the VETERAN contracts.
- Elite enemies and bosses can spawn with random enhancements to add versatility to enemies. Adding another layer of complexity to the fight

Welcome Bounty Hunters,

We started our journey with Killsquad around two years ago, and we have to admit, it feels both like yesterday and a long time ago all at the same time. Time flew so fast we can’t believe we are now close to the full release Yet during these two years we’ve also poured ourselves into testing, polishing, adding new content, creating updates, reading your comments and feedback, and fixing the game. It was intensive, but also very rewarding. We feel that as a studio, and people, we’ve grown. notes.title: Pre-release Update
notes.notes:
Bounty Hunters,

Welcome to the Killsquad Pre Release Update! This is our last step on our journey through Early Access. We've focused on polish and a few on-demand mechanics as requested by you. Of course, being part of our Early Access community, you guys get to enjoy it first. 

Here’s a summary of what’s included in this update:

[b]"Recovery"[/b] has been added to the game by popular demand, "Recovery" is a new mechanic where after being knocked back you can get up back into the fight faster, so you can avoid those nasty moments of knockback after knockback. This short opportunity to get back up by reacting at the right moment will help you keep the frenzy of the battle!

The [b]economy of the game[/b] has been tweaked as well, balancing a bit the importance of the shop, leaning more towards contract rewards with the new "ambush chest". Inside of them you can find and earn that sweet rare loot. We also balanced the rewards for some contracts to smooth the progression throughout all the difficulties!

[b]Single-player balance[/b]! All contracts from Recruit, Veteran and Plague contracts received a balance on time and difficulties. Now the progression curve should be a lot smoother. But don't worry, there are still some more harsh contracts for those seeking greater challenges!

[b]WASTELAND 7A received its last flavour asset pack[/b], with the laboratory theme now added to the map, giving it a unique identity to the world as a post-nuclear planet!

Also, there’s a lot more in there, such as polishing, more balance and bug fixing, a lot of bug fixing, and more bug fixing!

The update is now ready for you to download & enjoy. Please let us know your thoughts below. Finally, two last-minute requests:

[list]
[*]If you have friends who would like to try Killsquad, tell them to get it now. We will be rising prices soon for the public release, and we want you guys & your friends to enjoy it at the best possible price.
[*]If you haven’t done so already, and think we’re doing a good job, please consider leaving a review! We’re at a 69.50 review score now, we’d love to hit 70 before release, as that means the game moves to “Mostly Positive” reviews from “Mixed”. Every review counts, so if you have a spare minute or two, please leave one. You have no idea how much that will help us on release day.
[/list]
 

Until next time, Bounty Hunters!

Your Novarama Team

Welcome Bounty Hunters!

[previewyoutube=8fRoOyXaC_4;full][/previewyoutube]

The Faction and Reputation system is something that we’ve been working on internally for quite some time. We looked at your comments and feedback, and we decided to reduce the amount of exp required to go through the Reputation levels. We made it easier and faster for people to level up, making the whole experience feel less “grindy”. We also saw the things that you, the community, might want as rewards from this system, and we based our new rewards on your feedback.

In the last Ekaar update, we changed the Factions section, updating it visually and adding tons of lore of each faction for you to explore and get lost in our universe. With this update, we are adding the final touches: more and better rewards! Many of the rewards that were previously available have been updated, and new rewards added. There are 50 levels of Reputation to achieve, 3 badges, and 14 unique rewards per faction waiting for you to be unlocked, such as special perks, emotes, skins, and lots more.

notes.title: Killsquad Release Date delay and the reasons behind it
notes.notes:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

Quite some time ago we announced that Killsquad’s full launch will be in the Summer of 2021. To get straight to the point, unfortunately, we won’t be able to release the game this summer. However, the full release won’t be too far off from our originally planned date. We’re talking about a [b]few weeks/one month delay[/b] at most. Saying all that, it is only fair that we give you an explanation on why that is the case. So here are the reasons for the delay.

The first and the most important reason is that we want to make sure that Killsquad will be as good as it can possibly be. After all, you only launch a game once. We’ve been taking note of your feedback, as well as looking internally at all the things that we want to do and get ready for the 1.0 release. We’ll be adding extra content to the game, getting rid of annoying bugs, polishing a few more things, and loads, loads more. Pretty much, we feel that by giving the game (and us!) a bit more time, we can make Killsquad more enjoyable and fun for you. A bit more time in the oven will make the cookies taste just that little bit extra!

The other reason for the delay is that unfortunately, just like the rest of the world, our studio has been impacted by the COVID pandemic. We were impacted both professionally and also personally. It was a bit of a hard time for all of us here at Novarama. But we don’t want to dwell too much on this negative time, and we are now adjusted to the new “normal”. Our work is now progressing smoothly to the finish line.

We hope that you understand why we had to push the release date for a bit later, and we hope that you also feel that it’s a good decision as well. And don’t worry, the full release date of Killsquad will not be that far away! We will reveal a new date really, really, soon.

All the best, hope you’re enjoying your new hero Ekaar (let us know how you like him so far), and speak to you soon! And any questions, just fire away down below or on our socials.


Happy bounty hunting, 

Your Killsquad Team

The Core 2 Update is here! This update comes with major changes. The skill and upgrade system has been reworked. [b]PROGRESSION[/b]

In this update we have focused in reworking the core system of the character skills allowing full customization of your build using the new skill tree. Also, and maybe the more important change, your abilities are [b]automatically[/b] upgraded inside a contract using the upgrades and skills you preselected at the skill tree.

[u]TECS[/u]

A new unique currency is added to the game: TECS. They can be earned and found in contracts. Use these TECS to unlock Skills and Upgrades for a specific character in the Skill Tree. Look for them carefully as they exist in a specific amount for each character.

notes.title: Dev Diary: Roadmap update!
notes.notes:
Hello all!
After Christmas, we took some weeks off the Dev Diary routine to chart our roadmap for Killsquad. With that process now done, we’re ready to begin telling you what we are working on. Here we go!

[h3]Optimization & Asia[/h3]
We have received comments that Killsquad’s framerate is lower than it should: framerate drops, difficulty running the game in some hardware… this is especially true for our fans in Asia (Korea and China mostly). Many of you are playing Killsquad in Net-Cafés, which we love. But sometimes the framerate is low. So, we have one team optimizing the game for performance. You’ve seen some of this already on the recent Hotfix, but more is coming on the next major update. Expect a more fluid experience across all machines. This has the side benefit of helping a console version as well (more on this later!)

[h3]Crashes, bugs, stability[/h3]
In 2020, we had a game we needed to fix: there were systems still to be implemented or missing, so our focus was on the gameplay. Sales during Christimas 2020 have proven Killsquad is becoming a pretty good game. But that has introduced many bugs. We have a second team just focused on crashes, bugs, etc. Again, you saw some of their work on the Hotfix last week, but expect a push to polish the game so there’s no bugs at all.

[h3]Usability & UI[/h3]
Killsquad’s interface has been steadily growing as more systems were added: gadgets, talismans, portraits, cosmetics, quests… as a consequence of that, let’s say the interface is nowhere as logical or intuitive as it should be: some sections are out of place, some are hard to find. So, we are working on a full UI revision, to make sure things are as intuitive as possible. We’ll promote some sections, remove old ones, and make sure the interface works for you, not against you.

[h3]Skua[/h3]
The three points above are all about Quality of Life. And Quality of Life is super important. But so is content. So, we confirm on the next update you are getting Skua, a full new world with its own contracts, quests and enemies. Skua is the space station where the Feds build and train their army of robots, so it can move across the galaxy conquering rogue planets. Expect Skua to drop during spring, in a mega-update that will include also all of the other things mentioned above. 

[h3]Playstation? Yes! Playstation[/h3]
We are working on Killsquad for Playstation. There, we said it. Expect it to drop summer this year, both on Ps4 and Ps5. We have always loved this kind of A-RPG on console, from Helldivers to Gauntlet to Alien Nation, and we wanted to be there. The port is almost done, we just need to optimize it and rework some network systems. But yes, Killsquad is coming to console. There’s no plans for other consoles outside of Playstation that we can confirm at this point.

[h3]And more![/h3]
And that’s not all. We’re working on an opening cinematic. We’re seriously thinking about progression changes to make the game more fun for longer. We’re working on new cosmetics. We have a lot of things we want to share with you all. 2021 is gonna be a great year!

notes.title: Dev Diary Update
notes.notes:
Hello guys! What a recent two weeks we have had! Reviews are rising, sales are rising, we couldn’t be happier. So, first of all, THANK YOU guys for appreciating the effort we put in CORE. But we’re not here to talk about us: ego is the path to the dark side as the Master would say. Let’s talk about what comes next in Killsquad. Being an Early Access means you guys get an open window into our development process, so expect a design-heavy Dev Diary today. So, come on, grab your thinking hats! Here we go!

[h3]Public vs Private[/h3]
We have realized we have two communities in the game. Some of you want to meet new people to play with. Others prefer Solo/Private play. So, sometimes the game is actually very active, but there seems to be no-one to play with, as everyone is doing Private contracts. Both sides are right, and we’re trying to please both with a game that caters to both audiences. To better understand the issue, we put all contracts Public for a few days to understand what is going on under the hood.

As a result of our analysis, we are beginning to take action. First, we are working on a fix that will lower the overall lag in the game. It will also tell you from the contract map what the ping time will be on each contract, to ensure the best online experience. Giving you guys a good online experience is key to us, so we expect us to roll this out soon. But rest assured: private contracts will return. We appreciate your patience while we fix this.

[h3]Talismans[/h3]

One question we are asked a lot is: how will the new Talisman system work? What are passives gonna be like? Ok, here’s a deep-dive, thanks to Miki, the game’s Lead Designer:
[list]
[*] We want to give you better control on your hero’s build
[*] So, we want to give you items you can equip, that create passive mods that boost your hero in some way. Some may be stat boosts, some may be more creative stuff you will need to discover.
[*] These are the Talismans
[*] Talismans are ancient artifacts of power, owned by The Unseen.
[*] These Talismans have been shattered, and are now broken in pieces
[*] Talisman pieces can be found in some contracts, and also as a reward for beating the Colosseum: some Talismans on the recruit Colosseum, some on the Veteran
[*] So, to activate a Talisman, first you need to assemble it from its pieces
[*] Once the Talisman is assembled, you unlock its passive ability. This is vector-less, so Talismans don’t become old as you Vector up. So for example a Talisman can give you increased Dodge regen time regardless of what your Vector is
[*] On top of that, Talismans become better with use: the more you use them, the stronger they become, up to a cap in their power
[*] And you can equip two of them any given time, so better choose well which are your weaknesses to assess what do you need to boost. 
[/list]

As you can see, Talismans are a veteran / end game feature. They will begin appearing in late recruit, but we feel these are for pro players who really want to max out their heroes. Here's a first look at the Talisman UI:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/2f2ec61f179ac5f8eb75b0fb24c6b10f875d0815.jpg[/img]

Talismans will be deployed this Christmas, but will play a bigger role in our future updates, where we will unlock our endgame section (Inferno and Spec Ops where they will be much needed).

[h3]Cosmetics! Animations!
[/h3]
As you saw with Core, we are making sure we give you as many opportunities to customize your hero as we possibly can, within our design of “customize by equipment”: it’s the equipment what makes your hero different, not stats. 

Part of that is cosmetics, which we had way too little of: we had some skins, and that was about it. On the next update, this is going to change. You are going to get funky hats. Boots. Cool animations to celebrate victory (or defeat!). Today, we bring you a quick sampler of these. First, some cosmetic pieces of equipment:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/55149d719f1b0cba7e5513972e4e5313a1c638fc.jpg[/img]

And here is a cool Cass animation for you to trigger in game:

[previewyoutube=lc7lf4ndGqM;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Bienvenue a Killsquad! 我们很高兴您喜欢 Killsquad![/h3]

Yes, translations are here. If you download today’s build, there is support for:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Korean
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Italian
[*] Spanish
[*] Japanese
[*] English
[/list]
These are all human-made translations. But we know how this is a very sensible matter. So, as we did last time, we are publishing our [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mKunh7me0w2q8mPvhEcxNb50oRmTio9zsmXDDKYxauQ/edit#gid=659715333]localization file[/url]. 

If you find a mistake in your language and you want to reach out us, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]Discord server [/url]and go to the #bug-localization channel. We are aware of some issues, which we will fix next week with a Hotfix.

So that's it for today! What are you doing here still? Come on, go play!!!

notes.title: Killsquad’s new major update, CORE, launches today
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=tSGJ6TsbPWU;full][/previewyoutube]

After 7 months of hard work & feedback from the community, we are pleased to release CORE today, Killsquad's newest update. CORE brings deep changes to all internal game systems & redefines the Killsquad experience. Every piece of feedback we got, we took it on board. And vowed to fix all of them in a single, mega-update. CORE has been on Beta testing now for a few weeks, during which the recent review score of Killsquad on Steam has risen from 64 to well over 85. So, the wait is over. Welcome to CORE, we hope you like it.

[h3]New levelling up system
[/h3]
Before CORE, enemies levelled up: you levelled up, so did they. Bad idea: why keep playing, if enemies level up with you and the ratio stays the same? The full system is gone. Now, enemies have a static level. You don’t. So, level up to crush them mercilessly. And feel pleasure in doing so.

[h3]New enemies & enemy generations
[/h3]
If you out-level enemies, we need more of them. CORE brings many new enemies across all sections of the game. Plus, it brings Enemy Generations: we have created +30 new enemy variations: new behaviours, new color schemes, new attack patterns… so there’s much more to hunt and destroy.

[h3]Elemental resistance
[/h3]
Enemies, attacks and weapons now have elemental resistance. So you’ll need the right tool for the right monster. Don’t use a freeze gun on an ice monster, you fool! You can also equip gear that builds up resistance against certain types of damage. So if Helldörren is frying you, gear up to counter that.

[h3]Dual weapons
[/h3]
With elemental resistance, picking the right weapon is more important than ever. That’s why we give you dual weapons slots, with different damage profiles. Let’s call these the mob clearing and the boss buster weapon. Choose them wisely: both influence your level and your chances of survival.

[h3]Gadget system
[/h3]
In Killsquad, your character build comes from your gear. That’s why we introduce the Gadget system: consumable power-ups you can buy, carry with you and unbalance the battle. Life pools. Poison areas. Gadgets bring an unprecedented layer of customization, and mean life or death on harder missions.

[h3]Shop & reward system
[/h3]
Of course if we give you all this equipment, we need a place to go shopping, right? Enter the new shop! And also, pay attention to the contract end screens, these have all been revamped and now do a much better job at getting you excited about the new equipment you just earned.

[h3]New campaign map
[/h3]
This one is self-explanatory. Yes, a campaign map. A lovely one indeed, +20 contracts for you to unlock and master. Go check it out! And, while we are at it, new tutorials so all game systems are explained. 

[h3]Checkpoints
[/h3]
You have been crossing a perilous land for 45 minutes. Only to reach the final boss who, as bosses do, kills you in one strike. Back to the start! So unfair. We have fixed that. The game now automatically saves progress at key moments, so you can restart from there. More fun. Less frustration.

[h3]New rendering
[/h3]
We have replaced all the lighting code. Expect dark nights. Red sunsets. Rainy days. The kind of atmosphere that would feel extremely romantic, if it wasn’t because a ten ton monster is crushing your guts. So yeah, do kill the monster. But enjoy the views along the way.

[h3]Language support
[/h3]
Please be aware that CORE is temporarily only available in English and Spanish. A language pack including Italian, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Korean & Japanese support will be released next week as we confirm there are no bugs on the game.

[h3]Roadmap
[/h3]
CORE is just the beginning. Here is our Roadmap update. Christmas will bring cosmetics and Talismans. Q1 next year will take us on a journey to Skua, the base of the Feds. And summer next year we will unleash our endgame features and a fifth hero so the team building options expand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/d69b05f03c79d266effef0302b7733d4a135b6e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/c6b20d34f63d8741b13bd9320e6f33f6262f916c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Bug reporting
[/h3]

Killsquad is an Early Access game. As such, it is a product in development. Have encountered a bug? We are sorry. Please report it by joining our Discord community. Please do so here:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad
[/url]

You can report bugs on the #beta-bug-report channel. Please be specific describing the bug: the easier for us to trigger the bug, the faster we solve it. If you don’t like Discord, do get in touch directly at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url] with the bug info.


[h3]We need your help!
[/h3]
Do you like our game? Would you like to help an independent developer? Here is what you can do:

[b]Reviews![/b]
Please write a review. This is THE single most important thing you can do. Reviews do magic to the Steam algorithm. Or, if you wrote a negative review back in the day, and feel we’ve done a good job, do you know you can update your review? Reviews are the blood that keeps us alive!

[b]Social media follow:
[/b]
Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/killsquad]https://discord.com/invite/killsquad[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/killsquadgame]https://twitter.com/killsquadgame[/url]
And on the Steam forums

[b]Streaming![/b]
Stream Killsquad, post videos on Youtube. Tell the world about it. If you have a significant following, contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url], and we’ll try to support you in any way we can.

[b]Media[/b]
Are you a member of the media? We want to meet you! Contact us at [url=killsquad@novarama.com]killsquad@novarama.com[/url]

[h3]About Killsquad[/h3]

Killsquad is an action-packed 4 player action RPG where sci-fi mercenaries raid planets seeking fame and glory. With three planets to explore, over twenty unique contracts to master, more than 100 weapons and 30 unique enemies, Killsquad offers an adrenaline-pumping journey into a dystopian future full of blood and black humour. Killsquad is now on Steam Early Access, with an approximate launch date of Summer 2021. 

[h3]About Novarama[/h3]

Killsquad is developed by Novarama, a Barcelona-based independent games developer with +18 years of experience, 11 of them as a Sony exclusive studio. With a team of +40 people, Novarama's mission statement is to building innovative games for mass audiences. Killsquad is our first fully self-published game. Visit Novarama's website at [url=www.novarama.com]www.novarama.com[/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/234573b9b5d7b4a202088d724d92da48134e0469.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/bb9c232d46ecaab0ceea104ec2f7f62ec3d042e0.png[/img][/url]

And, of course, our art team is still working on Gears, our equipment. There's never too much of this in a game like Killsquad, here's today's batch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/7ba98c91f68bf40f5a648a4e3207ca47216cc2c7.png[/img]

On a non-visual update, here's two very important items:

1) We have shortened all contracts on Recruit, so they are around 15 minutes each. We feel less is more: shorter, more varied missions, with good replay value. Veteran will remain longer, of course. 

2) You'll remember on our last Gathering we said our driving force was Progression, specifically, giving you guys more ways to customize your hero. We are already adding:

- Twin weapons
- Six item slots
- Weapon elemental damage
- Our two gears, which now become visible

Okay, I am happy to announce we have decided to add 2 more slots, which we call "Permanents" for now. Permanents are our way to give you guys more control over passive skills. In the current system, most Passives emanate from the weapons & gears. So, when you changed your weapon, you lost the passive (say, a shield passive). This put players between a rock and a hard place: you wanted to keep the Passive skill, but at the same time you need to move on from that weapon as it's not strong enough.

Wouldn't it be amazing if you could somehow "lock" your favourite passives?

Enter Permanents! You can wear two of these, and think about them like "cursed amulets": Each Permanent generates one passive, say shield in the example above. The way it works is, when you get it (for example via the Colosseum of the Unseen) the Permanent is not charged. So it will have a negative effect on your passive. In this example, shield will be *lowered*. Still, by using the Permanent and beating contracts, the Permanent will be slowly charged, and its true passive will flourish. So for example a Permanent giving you 25% extra shield, may start taking 10% from your shield, so you need to work on it to unleash its power.

We are thinking Permanents will be tied to the Unseen, so expect them to drop on Colosseum Battles. But this is still being discussed.

We feel Permanents are a great way to further customize your hero, and at the same time enhance the game's progression. What do YOU think? Post your ideas on the forums, we are always there to read them!

So that is it for today! Lots of stuff, and more to come as we integrate all game systems. We expect to begin announcing our Beta date soon. Still lots of work ahead, but the game is coming together nicely. 

See y'all in the Outer Reach!!!

Of course when we released Genesis we got some negative reviews from the players who would have wanted us to tackle progression first. Still, as new players began discovering 
 Killsquad and entering, they began saying nice things about the update. Our recent reviews are actually really good (vast majority of the last 10 days of reviews are positive, thank you so much guys!), and the traffic we had for the Genesis release was as high as the Christmas Break one, so that’s great as well. It seems we're making real progress in delivering a cool game world full of places to visit and stuff to do.

So, now that Recruit is working much better, let’s move to Veteran, where we are going to double down on the content. You guys are gonna love the stuff we’re working on. 

Veteran is going to consist of 12 contracts, 8 of them happening in our 3 initial planets, and 4 more happening in a brand-new world, Skua, which is the home of the Federation Army. As Veteran is a big section of the game, we’re splitting it in two updates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/0f07cf54b24d1a0a42bda696b012271ffbcbb435.jpg[/img]
[i]the plague extends[/i]

On Veteran1, expect to visit new areas of our world, such as the Vasperiath nests, go on weird new quests such as one about collecting Queen Moggoth larvae, and many more. If you’re a classic Killsquad player, here you will meet the Nightbringers (which are gone from Recruit, if you noticed it), the Feds (same story), and the Omens of the Plague. So Veteran is gonna feel super distinct and unique. 

So again expect more quests, more unique locations, more Momma (she’s a blast, isn’t she?). And of course being Veteran, this is all going to come in a more challenging form factor, so get your gear ready: crossing one of these contracts is not gonna be a walk in the park.
Oh, I am happy to announce that following many requests from the community, we’re also working on an all-new boss, the biggest one we’ve done yet. She’s related to the Plague, so expect an epic boss battle. I don’t want to show anything yet, I want to save the surprise for you guys. But expect a very challenging boss with some really cool mechanics that feel fresh and old-school at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/b58675eeb1dfe36396d2995eb958fd099dbdb8a2.jpg[/img]
[i]more plague mayhem[/i]

We expect Vet 1 (which is still missing a commercial name) to drop second half of April, and of course about one week sooner for Beta members, so make sure you sign up.
Giving you a sneak peek of what comes afterwards, you're gonna fly into Skua, our 4th planet. Turns out, you’ve only met the light infantry of the Federation Forces. Skua is their battlestation, full of heavily armored robot soldiers. This is going to bring more content into Veteran, and a high-challenge zone. 

So as you can see we’re gonna make sure each and every contract feels special and unique. We want players to get a rock-solid game world full of hidden corners to explore.
Progression will come post-June. I don’t want to get into too much detail as it’s still under discussion, but suffice to say we’re listening to you guys. We feel our current approach has some pros, but also lots of cons: you get the feeling heroes don’t grow, no sense of true progression. And we want to give you guys the solid hero journey you desire and love. A journey where your hero becomes stronger, gains new skills, and finds loot along his quests. We will move into this area once we can guarantee your hours of gameplay are filled with content and variety, so expect a more “classic RPG” system that keeps you coming back to earn new loot and skills. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/7f715c17989459df5db166165ec4429370a1f5eb.jpg[/img]
[i]a mechanized bridge crosses Kemmekh[/i]

So as you can see we DO have a plan. It seems, based on reviews, that the plan is making an impact on your perception of the game, so we’re confident we’re on track. 
All we need from you is three very basic things:
[list]
[*] First, be patient. We all want games here and now, but this is a live development, and we can only progress so fast.
[*] Second, support us. We love to read stuff on forums. We love positive reviews. We love Twitter followers. Being indie is tough. But you guys make it all worth it. 
[*] Third, tell your friends about us. We feel we’re beginning to turn the tide, Killsquad is growing day by day. And we need you guys over there pushing us and motivating us. 
[/list]
That’s it for now! Gotta go back to the trenches. See you in the Outer Reach guys, Dani out!

notes.title: Genesis Update is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=sKIgEhprYaA;full][/previewyoutube]

Genesis replaces the whole first act of Killsquad. It affects all the Recruit contracts. It's our biggest update so far, so I wanted to take a moment to explain the vision behind it, and what comes next. You know we've been very open about our development process before, and this time it's not going to be any different. 

2019 brought the release of Killsquad, a good amount of sales, and a game we could iterate from. Killsquad was a lot of fun to play, but it was a small game. 

2020 for us is all about [b]VARIETY [/b]and [b]PROGRESSION[/b]. By variety, we mean we want you to visit more places, meet more enemies, enjoy more game experiences, all of this providing a sense of journey & adventure through the Killsquad world. By progression, we mean we want you to slowly build up your hero, see him/her get stronger, learn new skills & get new gear. And, all of this, keeping the core action & online loop intact.

So, let's start with variety. With Genesis, you're going to feel a very different game experience from 2 months ago. Here's the highlights you can go play TODAY:
[list][*] Quest system, where you receive and fulfill specific missions to progress through the recruit act. Gone is the time when you didn't know what to do next.
[*] Less contracts, but each more carefully crafted, so each mission does feel unique and special. There's no 2 contracts where you're doing the same stuff. 
[*] New enemies & enemy progression. Each mission brings new foes for you to encounter, including 2 brand new semi-bosses.
[*] New locations for you to visit, we'll let you discover those.
[*] New gameplay mechanics so you get more of the stuff you already loved
[*] Voice acting & storyline
[/list]

As a systems upgrade, we also added an in-lobby chat, so finding partners is now easier than ever. Or you can just hang out there and make new friends. 

With all this, the game should now feel very different. We can't wait to get your feedback, please do so in the forums. Because, guess what? we have 2 more variety-oriented updates lined up, let's call them Veteran Part 1 and Veteran Part 2.

Veteran 1 comes April and upgrades the first half of our veteran contracts. Visit the Vasperiath Nest. Meet Helldörren in his throne room. Watch as the Plague infects a planet. Meet the Federation in their crusade to control the galaxy.

Veteran 2 comes June and is the second part of our veteran experience. As announced, this takes place in an all-new planet, Skua, the military base of the Federation. So it's a brand new world, 100% new enemies, etc. 

In parallel to this, we're working on a big Progression re-imagining. We're hard at work designing the new progression system. Our goal is to implement that sense of growth and power you guys desire, so expect deep changes to be announced soon here as well.

For those of you who are veterans, don't worry, your progress isn't wiped: your weapons, your vector and your progress are stored. As the Quest system is brand new, you'll still face the first quest, as if you were a rookie. So I recommend equipping just basic gear, and jumping in on the new Quests with the new guys to have fun together. We hope you have a blast. And don't worry, we're preparing stuff for you guys as well. Watch this space for news regarding depth and progression sooner than you think.

That's it for today, have fun, and expect a roadmap update with details about Vet1 and Vet2 soon. 

If you want our classic patch notes with all the nitty-gritty, they are here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/910490/discussions/0/1742268065070110507/

Dani out!

notes.title: Roadmap update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello again, bounty hunters, welcome to 2020! 
[/h3]
Sorry we have been silent for some time: we have been really busy. After the New Year break, we took 2 weeks to discuss internally the future of Killsquad, so we could present it to our community. I am happy to say we're ready to share it today. But before we begin, a bit of context:

Killsquad is a self-funded game: there’s no publisher or secret corporation behind us: it’s just us, Novarama, a bunch of game veterans, doing what we feel is right to build a great game. We are lucky to be able to fund it via sales, so every euro or dollar we make goes back into improving the game. We're in Early Access, so the game is still growing. We don’t intend to get rich with this game: Killsquad was born and still is a passion project & a tool to learn about Steam & Unreal for us. As such, our design process is very reactive: instead of thinking "we are always right and we know it all", we read each and every negative review, and use those comments to drive our design process forward.

First, you guys complained about bugs. So we focused on fixing stability. Then, about not finding people to play. That's why we dropped 2 updates in a row to fix that. If you look at our negative reviews today, a lot of them admit the game is fun to play, but complain it feels repetitive and lacks progression. Which does make sense: as an Early Access game, we focused on the experience first, to then extend the size of the game. So, that's going to be our driving force for the first half of 2020: give you more variety, a richer game world and a deeper lore. 

How are we gonna do this? As it’s a huge undertaking, we’ll split the process in 2 big updates: the first one will come during February, and it will revamp the Recruit experience. The second one will come around April, focusing on Veteran. 

So, today, I’d like to show you all that’s coming to Recruit next month. 

First of all, we are reducing the number of contracts, so we can devote more time to make each one unique. So, we will offer 12 (down from 20) contracts on Recruit. By having less contracts, we can have more carefully designed ones and a better overall experience.

Contracts on Recruit will be unlocked progressively, so you’re not overwhelmed by the whole game. To do so, we will use our Quest System, which you saw a glimpse of in our Christmas Event. Quests will give you goals to fulfill, and a way to slowly unfold the world of Killsquad. These quests will also serve as a tutorial of sorts, making sure game systems are presented properly.

[previewyoutube=VwpERsoCoiA;full][/previewyoutube]

Then, contracts will be story driven, have voice acting, and will deliver a unique experience. So, whether you play solo, or with a squad, expect a more polished “campaign”.

Of course, to fill these contracts we will need more baddies, so there’s more stuff to discover. You’ve seen some of them already on Twitter. We’re bringing two new semibosses to the game. The first one is Rex Guerrilla, a servant of Helldörren:

[previewyoutube=OjcsJT6qFSg;full][/previewyoutube]

The second one is a fugitive from Biosystems Labs that you may encounter in your adventures on Wasteland7:

[previewyoutube=k6W9wLWyU7E;full][/previewyoutube]

Needless to say, we’ll need artwork to make those contracts feel different. We’re working on a big number of set pieces, so our universe feels richer. No big reveal today, you’ll have to wait til the update to check it all out, but expect new locations, NPCs, and so on. Here's a glimpse of things to come:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35068692/e5e4e64851172505d41db25a3c76988a4a3cb48d.jpg[/img]

Of course expect new gameplay constructs so there’s more stuff going on and more ways to have fun. Here’s some insider clips of random stuff we’re working on, from exploding barrels, to switches, to killing blades, shield areas, and many more. 

[previewyoutube=UM_dR265_9o;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=CEWrkHkG_bU;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=T3aB_bR2q7g;full][/previewyoutube]

By the way, all this work won’t prevent us from working on other game areas that also need some loving and care. So, on this same update in February, you guys are getting a lobby chat, to make the social aspect better and make finding team mates even simpler. 

[previewyoutube=zMVQdCLjIc4;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re now working to have all of this ready for the update. We hope we will continue to get your invaluable support. We’ll reveal the new Veteran section soon, which will bring a whole new planet & faction among a lot of other cool things. But we’ll talk about that when the time comes. 

For now, all we can ask for is your patience and support. Great stuff is coming. 
Novarama

Kemmekh has fallen into the Plague's claws, turning into a Plague core. Neighbor Solar Systems have tried everything to stop it without much avail. They crowd-funded a mission for you to eradicate the Plague. Time to get your hands dirty.

[h1]Omen of the Plague[/h1]

Make a Pact with an Omen of the Plague in exchange of Plague related rewards. But at what price...?

[list][*] These mysterious objects appear at the beginning of Cursed Contracts. An extra one appears in the middle of the contract. To start these Contracts, you must be cursed by the Omen.
[*] These Omens can challenge players to accept or reject its offer: Be cursed and, in exchange, you will gain Plague related rewards.
[*] Omens never spoils what the curse could be, so players must accept it or not its offer blindly.
[*] When Players are challenged, a pop-up will appear to everyone and it must be decided to accept its offer or not with a vote. If the voting ends up with a tie, it will be decided randomly.
[*] If the curse is applied, everyone will be cursed, even players joining in the middle of a match.
[*] 
[/list]


[h1]What's a curse? [/h1]
A Curse is a negative effect that varies from losing the maximum amount of health, to being chained with the rest of the players. When a curse comes into effect it will be applied to every player in the party. In exchange, if you survive the contract you will earn extra loots at the end of the match.  You can accept up to 4 curses at the same time, to earn more loots at the end of the contract. But you should be careful, you can end up paying dearly...

[h1]Next steps[/h1]
We met with Valve at PAX to discuss our issues with cyber cafés and lost progress. As a result, we are working on a new implementation of the services to work consistently, even with players who are playing from internet cafes. This is on public beta now, will be published to the community at large hopefully next week.
We are fixing gears and upgrades that don't work as intended if you are not the host of the server.
We are working on a blacklist for players and discussing on more options to combat griefers.
We will publish on Monday the second part of Unseen, which is the Federation Forces reveal. These will be part of our next update, but we wanted to show you how things are shaping up. 
Last, but not least, we will publish during next week an update to our roadmap. We're adding many things. Moving others. We have more details on things we announced. And we want to share it all with you.


[h1]Wrapping up[/h1]
We hope you have fun with Killsquad, and we hope you see our game grow. We met many of you at PAX last week and, as we said then, we're not gonna stop until this game is perfect. 

Still, of course, this is an Early Access, so much as we'd love the game to be finished, this is a product in development. If your game crashes, please send us your saved folder (C:\Users%USERNAME%\AppData\Local\Killsquad\Saved) here at killsquad@novarama.com

notes.title: Dev Update & Closed Beta program
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We've been silent for a few days, for reasons that will become apparent shortly. 

Basically, we're attacking the core of a few nasty bugs that have been reported by the community. That includes:

- Corrupted save game
- Zero Frames Per Second bug that happens when certain monsters appear
- Anti cheating measures 

To make a long story short, we are reviewing all our  infrastructure to accomodate the more than 65.000 players of Killsquad.

The problem is, these are quite fundamental changes and take a lot of testing to make sure all cases are covered. Some of you may be aware, some not, but we had to roll-back a build last Friday as a bug slipped through. And we DO have testers in house, but it's impossible to test all conditions on a live, online centric game: there's just too many combinations that can happen on a live session. 

Which brings us to the second part of the update: we are thinking about doing a Private Beta system to speed testing and ensure bugs are eliminated. Here's how the system will work:

- We will allow people to sign up for Betas. Read and, if you think this is for you, contact us.
- These must be people who do play the game a lot, so they can be good candidates to spot issues quickly. 
- They must be able to write in English.
- Private Beta users must be aware they will get builds that may have bugs in them. Nothing major: we won't set your house on fire. But assume you could experience crashes, corrupted save games, and general bugs.
- Then, whenever we have a build that has gone through our internal QA, we'll ship it to the Private Beta group for a few days. 
- We'll set up a communication system to receive bugs from these Private Beta users, so testing is faster as there's more eyes on the game
- Then, once the Beta clears, we push it to the public right away.

So, do you love Killsquad? Would you like to see the latest, assuming it can be untested? If so, can you send us an email to killsquad@novarama.com right away? Please put "Beta" as the subject. All we need to know is your territory, as we'd like to have people from different languages/time zones to maximize the opportunity. We may also ask you for hardware details as we have issues that affect specific types of machines (ultrawide monitors come to mind for example)

Thanks guys!
